purpose: Migration evidence for published ESM export names only. This inventory does not establish implementation or parity.

scope.artifact: Each artifact is named by the last path component of the pinned tarball URL. Module file paths include the archive prefix package/.
scope.specifiers: Manifest entry points only: package roots and import export-map subpaths. For @codemirror/lsp-client, the ESM root comes from main because there is no exports map.
scope.exportCounts: Count each export name once per module file. exportsBySpecifier counts the same names again for each manifest alias. Names are case-sensitive; neither default exports nor wildcard re-exports occur.
scope.legacyModes: No root or dist entry. The ./mode/* import map points to ./mode/*.js, so public specifiers omit .js. There are 103 ESM files with matching CommonJS and declaration files. The helper simple-mode is included.
excluded: CommonJS and CJS interop names, type declarations, and source, build, or test files that are not manifest entry points.
@lezer/lr ships package/dist/constants.js. Its exports map does not expose that file, and the file has no ESM export declaration.
@codemirror/legacy-modes exports ./package.json as JSON, not as a JavaScript ESM module.

unmappedDeepAlias.note: Node resolves this alias because no exports map restricts it. It adds no names and is not counted as a manifest specifier.

verification.integrity: Downloaded each pinned URL and compared the SHA-512 SRI of the compressed tarball bytes with its pin using Python hashlib, OpenSSL, and shasum.
verification.archiveCheck: Python tarfile and bsdtar agreed on all member paths. Checked each manifest name and version, matched every dist or legacy ESM entry point to an archive member, and resolved each listed specifier from the extracted archives with Node import.meta.resolve.
verification.exportCheck: Parsed each exact JavaScript entry point with Acorn 8.18.0. Compared every export name against the unevaluated V8 module namespace using Node.js 26.10.0. Linked pinned modules to one another; used synthetic modules for static imports outside the pins.

notes: The export names are known. Successful evaluation with real dependencies, host-specific behavior, and runtime values and object members are not verified.
@codemirror/language-data declares one export, languages. Its catalog uses dynamic imports; the modules and values loaded at runtime are not additional exports of language-data.
